values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder01
values.text:
<Red Guard speaking> 
 'General, we're all that's left of the assault force! We need to build a Command Center and get the radar up to receive new orders.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder02
values.text:
<Red Guard speaking> 
 'General, if we don't get our radar up we can't receive intelligence on the enemy's position. We need that radar.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder03
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, you're alive!?! We thought we lost you when the bridge went down. Well, you're not out of danger yet, so let's get started.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder04
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'First, you're going to need to finish your base. The barracks, reactor, and supply center are all essential to your survival, so finish constructing them immediately. I'll contact you again once your base is complete.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder05
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Excellent, your base is completeexcept for a War Factory. We need to get you one now. There should be a surplus base--with a War Factory--here'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder06
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'I don't know what condition the base is in, but it should allow you to build armored units to help your fight. Get there as soon as possible, General.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder07
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Now we know the GLA's reason for coming to Hong Kong: They're targeting key buildings around the city. Our main objective is to destroy all of the GLA's forces, but if we can also keep them from destroying those buildings, our leaders would be most grateful.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder08
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'If you can keep your radar operating, I can track the Terrorists for you and give you their possible targets.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder09
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, a Terrorist is leaving the Convention Center, and he's strapped with enough explosives to bring down a building! I'll mark the Terrorist in red on your radar. I'll mark his possible targets in yellow. Stop him before he reaches one of those targets!'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder10
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Another Terrorist has left the Convention Center! I'll mark his location in red. His possible targets are marked in yellow. Stop him, General.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder11
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, this building is a Terrorist target--we must protect it!'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder12
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, the Terrorists have taken over the Convention Center! You're going to have to destroy the Convention Center and the attached parking structures to stop the Terrorist threat.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder13
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Excellent, you've reached the surplus base. Hmmit's not much to look at, but it will allow you to build tanksand more War Factories, if you need.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder14
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'The Terroist threat is finished. Good work, General.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder15
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, I've detected GLA armored units on the move. They didn't come from the Convention Center, so the GLA must have another base somewhere in Hong Kong. Find that base and destroy it!'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder16
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'General, the GLA have brought their Toxin Tractors with them. You'll know them by the green ooze they spray. Keep your infantry units away from them and use your tanks to deal with this new threat.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder17
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Good work, General, you've destroyed the Toxin base. Now they shouldn't be able to build any more Toxin Tractors.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder18
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'Wait, General, there is a large force up ahead. I'll call for an EMP strike to clear the areastandby'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder19
values.text:
<'EVA' speaking> 
 'That should give you a clear path to their base. Let's finish this, General.'

values.label: SCRIPT:CHI02AudioHolder20
values.text:
<AutoFerry Capt. speaking> 
 'Finally, the military is here! Those Terrorists are ruining my business! If you put your forces aboard I'll take you out to the Convention Center. You can sneak in the backdoor and catch them by surprize. Jut hit the Transport button when you're ready.'

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingMove
values.text: Left click on units to select them. Selected units can be given commands. With a unit selected you can left click on the ground to give them a move command. Left click on enemy soldiers to order your selected unit to attack.

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingCommand
values.text: You have liberated a USA Command Center. Here you can use many of your special abilties. To choose technologies and special weapons click on the flashing General button.

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingExplor
values.text: The Fog of War around your units can be pushed back by moving into new and unexplored areas. The Fog shows you where you have explored and where you have not. Explore new areas to find enemy forces and resources to expand your army.

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingBarracks
values.text: You have liberated a USA Barracks. Buildings like this allow you to train new units. The Barracks trains soldiers. Left click on your new Barracks to see what soldiers you can train. Left click on a unit in the Barracks to spend the supplies to create that unit.

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingPilots
values.text: You have freed several Pilots. USA pilots are often veterans of many battles and they can enter your vehicles to provide their skills and experience to the crew of the vehicle. Vehicles with golden chevrons near them have experienced crews and are more effective in combat.

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingSupply
values.text: You have liberated a USA Supply Center. Supply Centers collect supplies, providing you with the resources to build new buildings and units. Each Supply Center automatically generates a single Chinook helicopter that will gather supplies for you.

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingDozer
values.text: You have liberated a USA Construction Dozer. Left click on your new Construction Dozer to see what buildings it can create. Select the War Factory and choose a location for it to be built. Once done creating the War Factory, the Dozer will be available for other construction projects.

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingUnits
values.text: Your new War Factory can be used to build vehicles like Crusader Tanks. Left click on a Crusader Tank to order it to be built. You can left click multiple times to order multiple tanks to be constructed.

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingPower
values.text: You have liberated a USA Cold Fusion Reactor. Reactors are used by American and Chinese forces to power their base. Your power bar indicates how much power your base has. If your base runs low on power base defenses may go off-line and your radar will go out.

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingAbilities
values.text: Some units have special abilities. Select a unit to see what special powers it has. Left click on the power to activate it. In the case of the USA Crusader Tank, each tank can build a single Battle Drone. Battle Drones are small robotic helpers that automatically engage enemies and repair their Crusader Tank in case it is damaged by enemy fire.

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingObjective
values.text: You have liberated an entire USA base and are now ready to carry the fight to the enemy. Each mission has mission objectives that you must follow in order to win the mission and to progress in your war against your enemies. Follow the mission objective to win the mission.

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingUrban
values.text: Civilian buildings can be occupied by soldiers. Order your soldiers to enter civilian buildings to get a defensive bonus. Civilian buildings occupied in this way are powerful strong-points for your troops and can be used to defend important routes into and out of your base.

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingTech
values.text: Civilian Objective Buildings can be captured by your Rangers. Holding these buildings will give you advantages against your enemies. Capture the Oil Derricks by selecting a Ranger, left clicking the capture button and then left clicking on the Oil Derrick itself. Oil Derricks provide you with additional resources as they pump oil.

values.label: SCRIPT:TrainingCrate
values.text: Crates contain bonus items for your soldiers that will increase their abilities. Additional ammunition, armor and other items can be found in crates. Order your soldiers or vehicles to move onto a crate to open it and collect the contents.
